name: Benjamin Caudill
biography: is founder and Principal Consultant of Rhino Security Labs, an information security consultancy in Seattle, WA. As a security professional, Benjamin has broken and secured environments from mobile startups to government agencies and Fortune 500’s. His security research and exploits have been published in Wired Magazine, CNN, CNET, Forbes and Geekwire, as well as presented at security conferences such as DEF CON 21.
